{"test_name":"Ledger_2297_Objection3","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection3\n{\n    private const string NestedCompositeResolverSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\nusing MessagePack.Resolvers;\n\nnamespace TestNamespace\n{\n    public partial class OuterContainer\n    {\n        public partial class InnerContainer\n        {\n            [CompositeResolver(typeof(StandardResolver))]\n            public partial class NestedCompositeResolver\n            {\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedCompositeResolver_EmitsExcludeFromCodeCoverage_WithBalancedDirectives()\n    {\n        (Compilation outputCompilation, GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics) = await RunGeneratorAsync();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.OuterContainer+InnerContainer+NestedCompositeResolver\");\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverSymbol);\n        Assert.Contains(\n            resolverSymbol.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterCacheSymbol = resolverSymbol.GetTypeMembers(\"FormatterCache\").SingleOrDefault();\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterCacheSymbol);\n        Assert.Contains(\n            formatterCacheSymbol.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n        GeneratedSourceResult generatedSource = runResult.Results\n            .SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources)\n            .Single(s => s.SyntaxTree.GetRoot().DescendantNodes().OfType<ClassDeclarationSyntax>().Any(c => c.Identifier.ValueText == \"NestedCompositeResolver\"));\n\n        SyntaxNode root = generatedSource.SyntaxTree.GetRoot();\n        var ifStack = new Stack<(int Depth, bool IsExcludeDirective)>();\n        var excludeDirectiveDepths = new List<int>();\n        int braceDepth = 0;\n\n        foreach (SyntaxToken token in root.DescendantTokens())\n        {\n            ProcessDirectiveTrivia(token.LeadingTrivia, braceDepth, ifStack, excludeDirectiveDepths);\n\n            if (token.IsKind(SyntaxKind.OpenBraceToken))\n            {\n                braceDepth++;\n            }\n            else if (token.IsKind(SyntaxKind.CloseBraceToken))\n            {\n                braceDepth--;\n            }\n\n            ProcessDirectiveTrivia(token.TrailingTrivia, braceDepth, ifStack, excludeDirectiveDepths);\n        }\n\n        Assert.Empty(ifStack);\n        Assert.Equal(0, braceDepth);\n        Assert.Equal(2, excludeDirectiveDepths.Count);\n        Assert.True(excludeDirectiveDepths[0] >= 3, $\"Expected #if directive inside namespace and nesting classes, got depth {excludeDirectiveDepths[0]}.\");\n        Assert.Equal(excludeDirectiveDepths[0] + 1, excludeDirectiveDepths[1]);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedCompositeResolver_ExcludesAttribute_WhenNetStandard20Defined()\n    {\n        await AssertExcludedWhenPreprocessorSymbolDefinedAsync(\"NETSTANDARD2_0\");\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedCompositeResolver_ExcludesAttribute_WhenNetFrameworkDefined()\n    {\n        await AssertExcludedWhenPreprocessorSymbolDefinedAsync(\"NETFRAMEWORK\");\n    }\n\n    private static async Task AssertExcludedWhenPreprocessorSymbolDefinedAsync(string symbol)\n    {\n        (Compilation outputCompilation, GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics) = await RunGeneratorAsync(symbol);\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.OuterContainer+InnerContainer+NestedCompositeResolver\");\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverSymbol);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\n            resolverSymbol.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterCacheSymbol = resolverSymbol.GetTypeMembers(\"FormatterCache\").SingleOrDefault();\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterCacheSymbol);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\n            formatterCacheSymbol.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n    }\n\n    private static void ProcessDirectiveTrivia(\n        SyntaxTriviaList triviaList,\n        int braceDepth,\n        Stack<(int Depth, bool IsExcludeDirective)> ifStack,\n        List<int> excludeDirectiveDepths)\n    {\n        foreach (SyntaxTrivia trivia in triviaList)\n        {\n            if (trivia.IsKind(SyntaxKind.IfDirectiveTrivia))\n            {\n                bool isExclude = trivia.ToString().Contains(\"!NETSTANDARD2_0 && !NETFRAMEWORK\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n                ifStack.Push((braceDepth, isExclude));\n            }\n            else if (trivia.IsKind(SyntaxKind.EndIfDirectiveTrivia))\n            {\n                Assert.NotEmpty(ifStack);\n                (int openDepth, bool isExclude) = ifStack.Pop();\n                Assert.Equal(openDepth, braceDepth);\n                if (isExclude)\n                {\n                    excludeDirectiveDepths.Add(openDepth);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static async Task<(Compilation OutputCompilation, GeneratorDriverRunResult RunResult, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> GeneratorDiagnostics)> RunGeneratorAsync(params string[] preprocessorSymbols)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references = (await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None))\n            .AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest, preprocessorSymbols: preprocessorSymbols);\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(NestedCompositeResolverSource, parseOptions) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        return (outputCompilation, driver.GetRunResult(), generatorDiagnostics);\n    }\n}\n"}
